y-m-81-05.title: Ole mkpụrụ okwu Hangul na-enweghị consonant ikpeazụ?
y-m-81-05.goal: Mata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ratio nke udi enwere ike ịdị na ratio e ji n'ezie n'ide, ma kwuo ozi na usoro achọrọ iji chọta nke ikpeazụ.
y-m-81-05.material: Otu mkpụrụ okwu nke Hangul ọgbara ọhụrụ bụ nke e mere site na consonant mbụ, vowel etiti, ma, ọ bụrụ na enwere, consonant ikpeazụ (batchim). Nkwekọrịta maka ọrụ a: gụọ nhọrọ 19 maka consonant mbụ, 21 maka vowel, na 28 maka consonant ikpeazụ, gụnyere 'enweghị consonant ikpeazụ.' Echiche: consonant mbụ, vowel na ikpeazụ ọ bụla nwere ike ijikọta n'efu, ma anyị na-agụ udi enwere ike ime. Anyị anaghị atụle ma a na-eji mkpụrụ okwu ndị ahụ n'ezie.
y-m-81-05.thinking.1: Ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ọnọdụ ndị enwere ike na ole ugboro a na-eji ha n'ezie
y-m-81-05.prereq.1: Ịmụba ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ, akụkụ na pasent
y-m-81-05.prereq.2: Ịnwe ike ịgụ aha mkpụrụedemede Hangul (nkọwa na mkpụrụ okwu bụ nke e mere site na mbụ, vowel, na ikpeazụ dị n'ihe ọmụmụ)
y-m-81-05.s.s1.prompt: Tụọ. N'etiti udi niile enwere ike ime, ihe dị ka ole akụkụ bụ mkpụrụ okwu na-enweghị consonant ikpeazụ?
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ okwu niile na-enweghị consonant ikpeazụ na ndị nwere consonant ikpeazụ, nke ọ bụla n'okwu nke ọnụọgụ nke consonant mbụ, vowels, na ikpeazụ.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.1: Mgbe ị chọtara ratio nke ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ, lee ihe na-eme ọnụọgụ consonant mbụ na vowel.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.a: Ị tụnyere ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ enweghị consonant ikpeazụ na ọnụọgụ ọnọdụ niile. Ị jiri eziokwu na ọnụọgụ consonant mbụ na vowel na-abanye n'akụkụ abụọ n'otu ụzọ.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.b: Enweghị consonant ikpeazụ bụ 1 n'ime consonant ikpeazụ 28 enwere ike. Gụọ ọzọ ole akụkụ nke ihe dum otu n'ime 28 bụ.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.c: Ịhụ òkè 'enweghị consonant ikpeazụ' n'ime nhọrọ consonant ikpeazụ 28 dị ka otu n'ụzọ asatọ buru oke ibu. Consonant mbụ na vowel na-amụba n'otu ụzọ n'ọnọdụ ọ bụla.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị ka ị kewara naanị abụọ, "nwere consonant ikpeazụ" na "enweghị", ma hụ ya dị ka ọkara na ọkara. Ọnọdụ nwere consonant ikpeazụ na-ekewa n'nhọrọ 27.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.explain: Mkpụrụ okwu na-enweghị ikpeazụ bụ 19×21=399, ma ngụkọta bụ 19×21×28=11172. Ratio bụ 399÷11172=1/28≈3.6%. A na-amụba ọnụọgụ consonant mbụ na vowel n'otu ụzọ ma enwere ikpeazụ ma ọ bụ na ọ nweghị, ya mere ratio na-aghọ 1 n'ime ikpeazụ 28.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.prompt: Ịhụ ratio e chọtara n'elu, otu nwa akwụkwọ kwuru, "Mgbe ahụ n'ide n'ezie kwa, mkpụrụedemede na-enweghị consonant ikpeazụ ga-apụta naanị n'ratio ahụ." Gịnị gbasara nkwupụta a?
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.0: Chee echiche ma 'ọnụọgụ udi enwere ike' na 'ọnụọgụ ugboro ha na-apụta n'ide' bụ otu ihe.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.1: Chee echiche nkwubi okwu ị ga-enweta ma mkpụrụ okwu ọ bụla pụtara otu ugboro, na ma echiche ahụ ga-abụ eziokwu.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.a: Mba. Mana ọ bụrụ na ederede na-aghọ ogologo nke ukwuu, ọ na-abịaru 3.6% n'onwe ya.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.a: Ụkpụrụ nke na-adaba ka ederede na-aghọ ogologo bụ ratio e ji n'ide. Ọ naghị aga n'ratio nke ọnụọgụ udi enwere ike.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.b: Enweghị ike ịmata. Ozi na enwere ụdị consonant ikpeazụ 28 nwere ike ịbụ nke ezighị ezi.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.b: 28 bụ nkwekọrịta nke ọrụ a. Okwu bụ ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ a kwekọrịtara kama ma enwere ike ịgbanwe ratio nke ọnụọgụ ka ọ bụrụ ugboro ojiji.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.c: Mba. Anyị ga-amata ole ugboro a na-eji mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla n'ide.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.c: Ị kewapụrụ ọnụọgụ udi enwere ike na ọnụọgụ ojiji n'ezie. Ị hụrụ ugboro ojiji dị ka ozi nke a ga-enyocha iche.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.d: Ee. Ọ bụ ratio n'etiti mkpụrụedemede niile enwere ike, ya mere ọ bụkwa otu ratio n'ide.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.d: Ratio nke "udi enwere ike" na ratio nke "mkpụrụedemede e ji n'ezie" dị iche. Ọ dabere n'ole ugboro a na-eji mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.explain: 11172 bụ ọnụọgụ 'udi enwere ike iji'. N'ide n'ezie, a na-eji ụfọdụ mkpụrụ okwu ugboro ugboro ma ụfọdụ fọrọ nke nta ka a ghara iji ha. N'enweghị echiche na a na-eji udi ọ bụla n'otu ugboro, ị pụghị ịgbanwe ratio nke ọnụọgụ ka ọ bụrụ ratio nke ojiji.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.prompt: Kedu ka ị ga-esi chọpụta ratio nke mkpụrụ okwu na-enweghị ikpeazụ n'ide n'ezie? Dee usoro ahụ na opekata mpe otu oke nke usoro ahụ.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.0: Họrọ otu ederede ị ga-agụ ma chee echiche otu esi ahazi mkpụrụ okwu ya n'otu abụọ (enweghị ikpeazụ / nwere ikpeazụ).
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.1: Chee echiche ma enwere ike ịtụkwasị obi n'nsonaazụ ma ị họrọ naanị otu ederede.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị dere ma otu ị si ahọrọ ederede ma usoro nke ime ratio site n'nsonaazụ e gụrụ?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mgbe ị dere oke ahụ, ị gosipụtara kpọmkwem 'ihe usoro a na-enweghị ike ịgwa gị'?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.0: Họrọ otu ederede, gụọ mkpụrụ okwu na-enweghị ikpeazụ, ma kewaa site na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ okwu ka ị nweta ratio. Mana otu ederede nwere ike ịdabere n'otu akụkụ site n'ihe omume, ya mere ị kwesịrị ịchịkọta ọtụtụ ederede ma gụọ n'otu ụzọ ahụ iji tụkwasị obi.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.1: Họrọ otu peeji nke akwụkwọ, gụọ mkpụrụ okwu na-enweghị ikpeazụ na ngụkọta mkpụrụ okwu, ma chọta ratio. Otu peeji nwere ike ịdị iche site n'udi ide, ya mere ị kwesịrị ịchịkọta ma tụnyere ọtụtụ udi ide, dị ka abụ na ederede nkọwa.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Enyere m dị ka oke na nsonaazụ na-adabere n'udi ide.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.2: Gụọ mkpụrụedemede na-enweghị consonant ikpeazụ n'otu ederede ma chọta ratio. Otu ederede nwere ike ịdabere n'àgwà nke ederede ahụ.

y-m-81-02.title: Ka anyị mepụta iwu afọ mgbakwunye n'onwe anyị
y-m-81-02.goal: Ghọta na iwu afọ mgbakwunye na-edozi nkezi ogologo afọ, mepụta ọtụtụ iwu na-eju ọnọdụ ndị ahụ afọ, ma tụnyere ma kọwaa nha njehie ha.
y-m-81-02.material: Oge Ụwa na-ewe iji gaa otu ugboro gburugburu Anyanwụ (afọ tropical) bụ ihe dị ka ụbọchị 365.2422. Afọ kalenda bụ ụbọchị 365 ma ọ bụ ụbọchị 366 (afọ mgbakwunye), ya mere anyị ga-ekpebi n'afọ ole ka a ga-agbakwunye otu ụbọchị. Anyị na-ede iwu dị ka 'tinye ụbọchị mgbakwunye L n'okirikiri nke afọ N,' ma nkezi afọ bụ ụbọchị 365+L÷N. Echiche: were afọ tropical dị ka ụbọchị 365.2422, ma tụnyere ka kalenda si pụọ site n'oge ndị ahụ site n'ọdịiche dị n'nkezi.

y-m-81-02.prereq.2: A na-enye uru ihe dị ka ụbọchị 365.2422 maka afọ tropical (oge Ụwa na-ewe iji gaa otu ugboro gburugburu Anyanwụ) n'ihe ọmụmụ.

y-m-81-02.s.s3.line.4: Nkezi afọ nke iwu a dị ntakịrị karịa ụbọchị 365.25, ya mere ọ dị nso na ụbọchị 365.2422 karịa iwu nke afọ mgbakwunye n'afọ 4 ọ bụla.
y-m-81-02.s.s3.explain: Ahịrị 4 ezighị ezi. Afọ 2000 bụ ọtụtụ nke 100 ma bụkwa ọtụtụ nke 400, ya mere site n'ahịrị 3 ọ bụ afọ mgbakwunye. Afọ 1900 na 2100 bụ afọ nkịtị. Ahịrị 5 ziri ezi: n'ime afọ 400, iwepụ ọtụtụ nke 100 ndị 4 site n'ọtụtụ nke 4 ndị 100 ma gbakwunye otu ọtụtụ nke 400 ndị 1 na-enye ụbọchị mgbakwunye 97, ya mere nkezi bụ ụbọchị 365.2425, nke dị nso na ụbọchị 365.2422 karịa ụbọchị 365.25 nke iwu afọ 4.

y-m-81-03.prereq.0: 'H3' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara maka ọkwa isi ike na nkwado nke nchịkọta mmepụta a. Ọ pụtaghị na e kenyere isiokwu ọ bụla n'ọkwa ọ bụla. A na-eche na ụmụ akwụkwọ nke mụtaworo mgbakọ na mwepụ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị (ọnụọgụ, okwu, ọrụ, na ihe ike ime dị mfe) na-agbalị isiokwu 'Mgbakọ na Mwepụ na Omenala'.
y-m-81-03.title: Itụba osisi yut: nsonaazụ niile nwere otu ohere?
y-m-81-03.topic: Ihe ike ime n'egwuregwu omenala Yut
y-m-81-03.goal: Kewaa ọnụọgụ nsonaazụ na ohere hara nhata, kpebie ka itụnyere ihe ike ime nke yut na mo si agbanwe mgbe e nyere data na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ, ma kwuo ozi a chọrọ.
y-m-81-03.material: N'egwuregwu yut, ị na-atụba osisi yut 4 n'otu oge, ma a na-ekpebi nsonaazụ site n'ole osisi na-ada na akụkụ larịị (afọ) n'elu. Afọ 1 bụ do, 2 bụ gae, 3 bụ geol, 4 bụ yut, ma 0 (azụ gburugburu niile) bụ mo. Echiche: a na-atụba osisi ndị ahụ na-emetụtaghị ibe ha (nwere onwe ha), ma ihe ike ime na otu osisi na-ada afọ n'elu bụ p. Maka osisi yut n'ezie, p na-adabere n'otu e si mee ha.
y-m-81-03.thinking.1: Ịhazi mkpebi gị na ntụkwasị obi gị mgbe ịhụchara data ọhụrụ
y-m-81-03.thinking.2: Igosi ozi achọrọ maka nkwubi okwu
y-m-81-03.prereq.1: Ịgụ ọnọdụ (iwu ngwaahịa), ngwaahịa nke ihe ike ime nke ihe omume nwere onwe ha, pasent na ruru
y-m-81-03.prereq.2: Ọbụna ma ịnwebeghị egwuregwu yut, ị nwere ike idozi nke a site n'iji iwu ndị akọwara n'ihe ọmụmụ naanị.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.prompt: Otu nwa akwụkwọ kọwara ihe ike ime nke ịtụba osisi yut dị a. Chee na ihe ike ime p na otu osisi na-ada afọ (akụkụ larịị) n'elu bụ 1/2. N'ahịrị kedu ka nkwupụta mbụ na-ezighị ezi na-apụta?
y-m-81-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kpọọ osisi ndị ahụ ①②③④ ma depụta ole n'ime ụdị 16 nwere kpọmkwem afọ 1.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gụọ n'ime tebụl ole n'ime ụdị 16 ka do, gae, geol, yut, na mo nke ọ bụla kwekọrọ na ya, ma tụnyere ha.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.0: E nwere ụdị nsonaazụ ise: do, gae, geol, yut, na mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.1: Ụdị nke osisi 4 na-egosi afọ ma ọ bụ azụ bụ 2×2×2×2=16, ma ọ bụrụ p=1/2, ụdị 16 ndị a niile nwere otu ohere.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.2: Ma e nwere nsonaazụ ise, ya mere nsonaazụ ọ bụla nwere otu ohere.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere probability nke yut bụ 1/5, ma probability nke mo bụkwa 1/5.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-adị njọ nke mbụ n'ahịrị 3. Inwe nsonaazụ 5 anaghị eme ka ha nwee otu ohere. N'ime udi 16, do (afọ 1) nwere 4, gae nwere 6, geol nwere 4, ma yut na mo nwere 1 nke ọ bụla, ya mere probabilities bụ 4/16, 6/16, 4/16, 1/16, 1/16. Ahịrị 4 bụ nkwubi okwu nke sitere n'nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi dị n'ahịrị 3.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.prompt: A na-ekpughe ihe ndị a otu otu. Oge ọ bụla, họrọ echiche gị gbasara ajụjụ a: 'Nke na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa, yut (afọ 4 niile) ma ọ bụ mo (azụ 4 niile)?'
y-m-81-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chee echiche otu ozi e nyere ugbu a si agwa gị ụkpụrụ p n'ụzọ doro anya.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.hint.1: Dee probability nke yut na probability nke mo site n'ịkewa ha n'probability afọ na probability azụ nke osisi ọ bụla.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.info: Osisi yut 4 niile bụ osisi yut kwesịrị ekwesị nwere p=1/2. N'ime udi 16, yut bụ udi 1 (afọ niile) ma mo bụkwa udi 1 (azụ niile).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.ask: Nke na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa, yut ma ọ bụ mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.ask: Nke na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa, yut ma ọ bụ mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.after: Ọ bụrụ na p=1/2, yut na mo abụọ bụ 1/16, ya mere ha hà nhata. Mana osisi yut n'ezie nwere ike ọ gaghị enwe p hà nhata 1/2 kpọmkwem.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Yut na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa. Ọ bụ ihe okike karịa ka afọ na-eche elu ihu.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Ị kwuru p=1/2, ya mere afọ na azụ nwere otu ohere. Ihe kpatara a adabaghị n'echiche e nyere.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Mo na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa. Mo na-ebuga gị ebe dị anya, ya mere ọ pụtara na ọ siri ike karịa.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Akara buru ibu na probability dị nta bụ ihe dị iche. N'okpuru echiche a, ị kwesịrị ịtụnyere site n'ọnụọgụ udi.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Nsonaazụ abụọ ahụ bụ udi 1 n'ime 16, ya mere ha na-apụta otu ugboro.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Ị tụnyere site n'ịgụ ọnụọgụ udi. Ntụnyere a na-adabere n'echiche na p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.info: Ị tụbara otu osisi yut n'ezie ugboro 100, ma afọ pụtara ugboro 60 (were na osisi anọ niile nwere otu udi).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.ask: Gịnị ka ị chere gbasara yut na mo mgbe ị hụrụ data a?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.after: Ohere inweta 60 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ime 100 mgbe p=1/2 bụ ihe dị ka 3%. Ọ bụghị ihe a na-ahụkarị, mana ọ bụghị ihe na-ekwe omume, ya mere ma ị chere na p buru ibu karịa 0.5 ma ọ bụ debe ikpe mbụ gị, ọ bụ ezi uche ma ị kwuo ihe akaebe gị. Ọ bụrụ na p=0.6, yut bụ ihe dị ka 0.130 ma mo bụ ihe dị ka 0.026, ya mere yut nwere ohere ihe dị ka okpukpu 5.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Ọ bụ 60, ya mere anyị nwere ike ịkwụsị p=0.6, ma anyị nwere ike ikwu na yut na-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 5 karịa mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ntụba 100 abụghị ọnụọgụ buru ibu. 0.6 bụ atụmatụ, ọ bụghị ụkpụrụ kwụsịrị, ma ọ nwere ike ịbụ 0.55 ma ọ bụ 0.65.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.b: p nwere ike ịbụ ihe dị ka 0.6, ya mere yut nwere ike ịpụta ugboro ugboro karịa mo. Mana lezie anya n'ole ugboro ugboro karịa.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Ị kwukwara gbasara enweghị nkwenye n'atụmatụ ahụ. Ikpe gị na-ejikọta ọnụọgụ data na ntụkwasị obi gị.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Afọ pụtara ugboro 60 ma azụ ugboro 40, ya mere ratio nke yut na mo bụkwa 60:40, ihe dị ka okpukpu 1.5.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Maka yut, osisi anọ niile ga-egosi afọ, ya mere ọ bụ p e mụbara ugboro anọ. Ị pụghị iji ratio nke otu osisi dị ka ọ dị.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.d: 60 n'ime 100 nwere ike ime site n'ihe omume, ya mere ka enwere obere ihe kpatara ịhapụ ikpe mbụ na p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Ị tụlere oke ihe omume nwere ike ịkọwa ma debe ikpe mbụ gị. Ị nwekwara ike ichee ruo ebe ole site na oke ahụ ka ọ na-esi ike ịkpọ ya ihe omume.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.info: Osisi anọ ahụ dị iche n'etiti ibe ha: osisi abụọ nwere probability afọ 0.6, ma abụọ ndị ọzọ nwere probability afọ 0.4 (osisi anaghị emetụta ibe ha).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.after: Yut bụ 0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4=0.0576 ma mo bụ 0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6=0.0576, ya mere ha hà nhata. Mgbe p nke osisi niile bụ otu, yut na mo hà nhata naanị mgbe p=1/2, mana mgbe osisi ọ bụla dị iche, ha nwere ike ịdị hà nhata otú a site n'ihe omume.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Yut na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa, n'ihi na ụfọdụ osisi nwere probability afọ 0.6.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Enwere osisi nwere 0.6, mana enwekwara osisi nwere 0.4. Dee probabilities nke yut na mo nke ọ bụla dị ka ngwaahịa ma tụnyere ha.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Enweghị ike ikpebi ya site n'ọnọdụ na osisi anaghị emetụta ibe ha naanị.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Site n'ọnọdụ 'ha anaghị emetụta ibe ha,' ị nwere ike ịmụba probabilities. Lelee ọzọ ma ụkpụrụ ndị ị chọrọ e nyela ha.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Mo na-apụta ugboro ugboro karịa, n'ihi na ụfọdụ osisi nwere probability afọ dị ala.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Maka mo, ị ga-atụlekwa na osisi nwere 0.6 na-adakwa n'azụ nwere probability 0.4.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Ha hà nhata. Yut bụ 0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4 ma mo bụ 0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6, ya mere ngwaahịa bụ otu.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Ị tụnyere yut na mo site n'ide nke ọ bụla dị ka ngwaahịa. Ị chọpụtara na a na-eji otu ọnụọgụ ahụ n'abụọ, ebe osisi na-egosi afọ n'otu akụkụ ma azụ n'ọzọ.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.reflect: Kedu ka ikpe gị mgbe p=1/2 si gbanwee mgbe data ntụba 100 gasịrị na mgbe ị mụtara na p dị iche site n'osisi ruo osisi? Kwuo ma ozi ọhụrụ ahụ gbanwere ikpe gị ma ọ bụ gbanwee ka ị si nwee nkwenye.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.prompt: Iji kwuo 'yut na mo nwere otu ohere,' gịnị ozi ọzọ achọrọ, ma kedu ka ị ga-esi tụnyere ozugbo ị nwere ya? Dee ya.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.0: Dee n'akụkụ ibe ya otu osisi ọ bụla ga-esi da maka yut na otu osisi ọ bụla ga-esi da maka mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.1: Chee echiche ụkpụrụ ndị ị chọrọ ịmara iji tụnyere abụọ ahụ site n'ọnụọgụ.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.placeholder: Ihe atụ: Buru ụzọ achọrọ m ịmara ...
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ozi ị dere ọ̀ na-eji n'ezie gbakọọ probability nke yut na probability nke mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị chekwara ma osisi na-emetụta ibe ha (nnwere onwe)?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị kewapụrụ 'mgbe p niile bụ otu' na 'mgbe osisi ọ bụla dị iche'?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.0: Ịchọrọ ịmara probability p na osisi ọ bụla na-ada afọ elu. Ọ bụrụ na osisi anọ niile nwere otu p, yut na mo hà nhata naanị mgbe p=1/2; ọ bụrụ na osisi ọ bụla dị iche, ị ga-atụnyere ngwaahịa probabilities afọ nke osisi ọ bụla na ngwaahịa probabilities azụ ha.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.1: Ịchọrọ ịmara probability nke osisi ọ bụla na-ada afọ elu na ma osisi na-emetụta ibe ha (nnwere onwe). Site n'ụkpụrụ ndị ahụ, mụbaa probabilities afọ niile maka yut na probabilities azụ niile maka mo, ma tụnyere.

y-m-81-06.title: Ọ bụrụ na otu vertex na-arụ ọrụ, ọ̀ bụ na ụdị dum na-arụ ọrụ?
y-m-81-06.topic: Ụdị regular polygon na ịkpuchi plane
y-m-81-06.goal: Chọta ọtụtụ njikọta nke akụkụ ha n'otu vertex na-agbakwunye ruo 360°, ma kpebie na ọnọdụ a ezughị iji jupụta plane dum.
y-m-81-06.material: Mgbe ị na-eme ụdị, ị na-ejikọta regular polygon tiles n'enweghị oghere na n'enweghị ịgafe ibe. Akụkụ nke tiles na-ezute n'otu vertex ga-agbakwunye ruo 360°. A na-ekpebi nha nke otu akụkụ nke regular n-gon site na n (regular triangle 60°, regular square 90°, regular hexagon 120°). N'ọrụ a anyị na-ele naanị ọnọdụ ebe regular polygons atọ na-ezute n'otu vertex, ọnụọgụ akụkụ bụkwa ọnụọgụ eke site na 3 ruo 50.
y-m-81-06.thinking.1: Ịchọta njikọta dị iche iche na-emezu oke
y-m-81-06.thinking.2: Ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ọnọdụ dị mkpa na ọnọdụ zuru ezu
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Nha nke akụkụ n'ime nke regular polygon (geometry ụlọ akwụkwọ etiti), akụkụ na idozi ntụnyere
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Echiche gbasara regular polygons na-agbaji isi ntụ (akụkụ na-agbakwunye ruo okirikiri zuru ezu)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Buru ụzọ chee echiche. Ewezuga regular hexagons atọ (6,6,6), kedu njikọta ndị ọzọ nke regular polygons atọ n'otu vertex nwere akụkụ na-agbakwunye ruo 360°? (N-gon nwere akụkụ n, ma n dị opekata mpe 50.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na enwere otu regular triangle (60°), chee echiche ihe ngụkọta akụkụ nke polygons abụọ ndị ọzọ ga-abụ.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri otu usoro ahụ mgbe enwere otu regular square (90°), ma chọta njikọta ole na ole.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Regular polygons na-abụghị regular triangle, square, na hexagon (dị ka regular octagon) nwekwara akụkụ. Gịnị ma ị nwalee otu ma ọ bụ abụọ n'ime ha?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.b: Enwere naanị njikọta ole na ole nwere regular triangle.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Lelekwa ma enwere njikọta na-enweghị regular triangle. Kedu maka ngụkọta nwere regular pentagon ma ọ bụ regular octagon?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Ị hapụrụ na enwere ike iji polygons na-abụghị regular triangles, squares, na hexagons. Ị nwere ike ịnwale ozugbo iji lelee ọnụọgụ.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: O siri ike ịchọta ihe kpatara enwere naanị otu ọzọ. Gụọ ozugbo ole njikọta ị nwere ike ime site n'iji polygons na-abụghị regular triangle, square, na hexagon.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọọ ha n'onwe gị n'nzọụkwụ na-esote, ị ga-ahụ na enwere njikọta 10 n'ozuzu, gụnyere (6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Chọta ma tinye njikọta 4 dị iche nke regular a-gon, regular b-gon, na regular c-gon na-ezute n'otu vertex ma akụkụ na-agbakwunye kpọmkwem ruo 360°. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, ọnụọgụ eke niile. Gụọ njikọta nwere usoro dị iche dị ka otu.)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mee tebụl nke nha nke otu akụkụ nke regular n-gon ma dee ole na ole malite na 3.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ a kacha nta, chọta ihe ngụkọta akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ ga-abụ, mgbe ahụ gbanwee b.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ akụkụ bụ ọnụọgụ eke site na 3 ruo 50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọnụọgụ akụkụ ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ eke site na 3 ruo 50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ị tinyere ha n'usoro a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Biko tinye ha n'usoro a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Akụkụ atọ ahụ na-agbakwunye kpọmkwem ruo 360°.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Akụkụ atọ ahụ anaghị agbakwunye ruo 360°.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Lee (5,5,10) n'etiti njikọta ị chọtara. N'otu vertex, regular pentagons abụọ na otu regular decagon nwere ike ijupụta 360°. Mgbe ahụ njikọta a naanị ọ̀ nwere ike ime ụdị nke na-ejupụta plane dum n'enweghị oghere?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Se vertices nke udi ndị dị nso gburugburu otu akụkụ nke regular decagon ma lelee ma otu njikọta ahụ na-aga n'ihu.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.1: Mgbe regular pentagons abụọ zutere n'akụkụ, lelee ma vertex dị nso na-enyekwa otu njikọta ahụ.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Otu isi ntụ ịkwekọ ezughị ezu ka ịmara. Ị ga-elele iche na vertices dị nso kwekọkwa.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Ị kewapụrụ ịkwekọ n'otu isi ntụ na ịkwekọ ebe niile. Ị hazịrị ihe bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa na ihe bụ ọnọdụ zuru ezu.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: Naanị (4,6,12), njikọta nke na-eji udi atọ niile, nwere ike ijupụta plane dum n'enweghị oghere.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: (6,6,6) na (4,8,8) nwekwara ụdị nke na-ejupụta plane dum. Ọnụọgụ udi abụghị ụkpụrụ.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Akụkụ n'otu vertex na-agbakwunye nke ọma, ya mere ịga n'ihu n'otu ụzọ ahụ ga-ejupụta plane dum mgbe niile.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Akụkụ n'otu isi ntụ ịgbakwunye nke ọma bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa. Ma vertices dị nso na-arụkwa ọrụ na otu njikọta bụ okwu dị iche.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Ọnụọgụ njikọta na-arụ ọrụ n'otu vertex hà nhata mgbe niile ọnụọgụ ụdị na-ejupụta plane.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Ajụjụ bụ ma njikọta ọ bụla na-ejupụta plane dum. Enweghị ihe kpatara ọnụọgụ njikọta na ọnụọgụ ụdị ga-abụ hà nhata.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Akụkụ n'otu vertex ịgbakwunye ruo 360° bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa, ọ bụghị nke zuru ezu. Dị ka e kwuru ruo ugbu a, n'ime 10 dị n'elu, naanị (3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), na (6,6,6) na-ejupụta plane dum site n'otu usoro vertex, ma (5,5,10) enweghị ike ijupụta plane dum n'ihi na ịga n'ihu na vertices dị nso na-eduga na mgbagha.
